about: Philemon is a short letter from Paul asking a friend to forgive and welcome someone back.

pages.title: Welcome Him Back
pages.scene: Two men shaking hands as brothers
pages.text: Onesimus had run away from his master, Philemon. Then he met Paul and believed in Jesus. Paul sent him back with a letter: "Welcome him like a brother, like you'd welcome me. If he owes you anything, I'll pay it."
pages.lesson: Forgive and welcome others like family.
